source:
@@U01924@@
(In chorus.)

@@U01925@@
Their magic salve makes witches hale, And any old rag will do for a sail, Any old tub can fly through the sky, You either fly now, or you'll never fly.

@@U01927@@
(In chorus.)

@@U01928@@
And when we've sailed around, around The peak, then sweep along the ground, And scour the heath to its farthest reaches With endless swarms of lowering witches.

@@U01929@@
(They alight.)

@@U01931@@
They jammer and jolt, they jabber and justle, They whiz and whirl, babble and bustle, They flash and spark, stink, and burn, And all things topsy-turvy turn! The truly hurly-burly which is Mother's milk to hovering witches! Stick close to me now or well be swept apart. Where are you?

@@U01933@@
(In the distance.)

@@U01934@@
Here!

@@U01936@@
What, dragged off so far already? I guess [’ll have to show them who’s master here. Make way! Squire Nick is coming through! Make way there, make way, good people! —Here, Doctor, hold on tight! One grand leap and we're free of this mob that’s too wild even for me.
translation:
@@U01924@@
（齐声）

@@U01925@@
他们的神奇药膏使女巫精神焕发，任何旧布都可以做帆，任何旧浴缸都可以飞过天空，你要么现在飞，要么永远不会飞。

@@U01927@@
（齐声）

@@U01928@@
当我们绕着山峰航行时，然后沿着地面扫荡，并用无尽的低下女巫群将荒野冲刷到最远的地方。

@@U01929@@
（他们下了车。）

@@U01931@@
它们干扰和震动，它们叽叽喳喳和吵闹， 它们呼啸和旋转，喋喋不休和忙碌， 它们闪烁和火花，发臭，燃烧， 所有的东西都颠倒了！真正的喧闹，是盘旋女巫的母乳！现在就靠近我吧，不然我们就会被扫地出门。你在哪里？

@@U01933@@
（在远处。）

@@U01934@@
在这里！

@@U01936@@
怎么，已经拖这么远了？我想[必须让他们知道谁才是这里的主人。让路！乡绅尼克来了！让路，让路，好人们！ ——来了，博士，抓紧了！一次巨大的飞跃，我们就摆脱了这群即使对我来说也太狂野的暴徒。
